The claim states that the color is calculated as $color = max(C_{SH}(dir), 0.0)$, citing source [S1]. Source [S1] explicitly states: 'The color the lobes are added to is clamped to zero first... Many splats have a negative base color, which would otherwise absorb part of the highlight.' It also notes that the lobe contribution is added to the 'SH / base color'. While the claim uses the variable $C_{SH}(dir)$ which might imply the full SH evaluation, the core assertion that the base color component is clamped to zero (i.e., $max(base, 0.0)$) before adding specular lobes is directly supported by the text. The notation in the claim is a simplified representation of the clamping operation described in the evidence.
